query: Периодически выбирай новые записи из PostgreSQL и публикуй их в Kafka topic analytics.events в формате JSON.

runs.yaml_pim:
flow:
  id: postgres_to_kafka_events
  name: PostgreSQL to Kafka Events Pipeline
  description: Periodically select new records from PostgreSQL and publish to Kafka
    topic analytics.events in JSON format
triggers:
- id: trigger_schedule
  type: schedule
  condition: every 5 minutes
sources:
- id: source_postgres
  name: PostgreSQL Source
  type: PostgreSQL
  location: '{{POSTGRES_TABLE}}'
  connection:
    properties:
      host: '{{PG_HOST}}'
      port: '{{PG_PORT}}'
      database: '{{PG_DATABASE}}'
      username: '{{PG_USERNAME}}'
      password: '{{PG_PASSWORD}}'
      query: SELECT * FROM {{POSTGRES_TABLE}} WHERE updated_at > '{{LAST_CHECK_TIMESTAMP}}'
processing_elements:
- id: process_serialize_json
  name: Serialize to JSON
  operation: Serialize
  config:
    format: json
sinks:
- id: sink_kafka
  name: Kafka Sink
  type: Kafka
  location: analytics.events
  connection:
    properties:
      bootstrap.servers: '{{KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS}}'
      topic: analytics.events
processed_data:
- id: json_records
  format: json
links:
- from_id: source_postgres
  to_id: process_serialize_json
  data_ref: json_records
- from_id: process_serialize_json
  to_id: sink_kafka
  data_ref: json_records
